steps.label: The SWAP detour

code:
Graph distance 3 → 2 SWAPs needed
2 SWAPs × 3 CNOTs = 6 CNOTs
+ 1 CNOT for the real gate = 7 total

Direct gate error:  ~0.5%
Routed (7 ops) error: ~3.4%
(1 − (1 − 0.005)^7)
caption: Routing alone pushes the error chance from about 0.5% to about 3.4% — nearly 7x higher — for one logical gate, before the computation even does its real work.
